structure.summary: A single joint copula law connects age, recorded sex, BMI, TC and HDL. Positive margins use lognormal distributions; age is an adult-boundary shift plus a lognormal age excess. Navrongo pooled arithmetic moments supply marginal BMI and lipid anchors. The three rural Ashanti unadjusted Spearman coefficients supply the BMI–TC–HDL copula submatrix through an explicit Gaussian-copula bridge. All remaining latent correlations are declared demographic assumptions, not unidentified relationships silently set to zero. Source statistics are transported as fixed scenario parameters; the requested age/sex/BMI-adjusted raw-scale projections are derived from the resulting joint law.

population_moments.notation: A denotes age excess, B BMI, T TC, H HDL, S the latent recorded-sex score, and F=I(sex=='F'). For i in {A,B,T,H}, m_i and d_i are the corresponding mean_above_offset and sd_above_offset in model_spec, and s_i=sqrt(log(1+(d_i/m_i)^2)). R is the latent correlation matrix constructed by the specified rank bridge and latent links. Let p=model_spec.recorded_sex.probability_F and q=Phi^-1(1-p).
population_moments.continuous_covariance: C_ij = m_i*m_j*(exp(s_i*s_j*R_ij)-1), for i,j in {A,B,T,H}. The fixed age offset does not change covariances.
population_moments.sex_covariance: C_iF = C_Fi = m_i*(Phi(s_i*R_iS-q)-p); C_FF=p*(1-p). This follows from the exponentially tilted normal integral for E[X_i*I(S>q)].
population_moments.projection_definitions: V=[[C_AA,C_AF,C_AB],[C_AF,C_FF,C_FB],[C_AB,C_FB,C_BB]]. For Y in {T,H}, k_Y=[C_AY,C_FY,C_BY]^T. Let e_B=[0,0,1]^T, c=model_spec.analysis_scaling.lipid_mmol_L_to_mg_dL, and d=model_spec.analysis_scaling.bmi_increment_kg_m2.
population_moments.eligibility_and_design: All generated records satisfy the common analysis eligibility with probability one. With an intercept, the slopes on raw age, F and BMI are V^-1*k_Y. Centering and rescaling the supplied design columns preserves the projection space; its BMI coefficient is d times the raw-BMI coefficient. The expressions reported below are exact analytic real values in the fixed specification, not numerically evaluated or finite-sample estimates.

parameter_provenance.meaning_operator: Joint dependence family and standard-normal latent identification convention. Natural logarithms parameterize the positive margins.
parameter_provenance.scale: Latent Gaussian copula and recorded-variable margins
parameter_provenance.derivation: Monotone exponential transformations preserve continuous pairwise ranks. A thresholded normal score represents the categorical field.
unverified_assumptions: One smooth Gaussian copula adequately represents the selected population, without explicit site or lifestyle mixture components.
Lognormal tails are acceptable for this construction; they are not established by the source moments.
The natural-log parameterization does not resolve or use the ambiguous log bases of any reported source regressions.

parameter_provenance.meaning_operator: Adult boundary offset 18 years; unconditional mean and SD of age excess are 25 and 15 years. Thus age has model mean 43 years and SD 15 years.
parameter_provenance.scale: Arithmetic moments of age excess; continuous recorded age

source_pointers.original_locator: Investigator-selected prospective eligibility: minimum age inclusive 18, no supplied maximum.

parameter_provenance.derivation: The boundary is task-declared, not a cohort-derived age statistic. The age-excess moments are assumed. For each lognormal margin, log-variance=log(1+(SD/mean)^2) and log-location=log(mean)-log-variance/2.
unverified_assumptions: The demographic composition is unspecified; neither Navrongo's restricted-age distribution nor another source age distribution is imported.
The shifted-lognormal support is age>18, with closure including 18 and no finite upper endpoint.
There is no separate age-reporting error or heaping process.

parameter_provenance.meaning_operator: Unconditional probability of recorded F is 0.5; F occurs above the corresponding standard-normal quantile, otherwise M.
parameter_provenance.scale: Marginal probability and literal categorical coding

parameter_provenance.derivation: Threshold q=Phi^-1(1-p_F) gives P(F)=p_F. Sex is dependent on other variables through the specified latent correlations.
unverified_assumptions: The balanced recorded-sex mixture is a scenario choice, not the source or target observed composition.
No biological interpretation beyond the admitted literal codes is required.

parameter_provenance.derivation: Under a continuous Gaussian copula, rho_S=(6/pi)*asin(R_ij/2), hence R_ij=2*sin(pi*rho_S/6). This bridge specifies the full pairwise copula, after which lognormal raw moments and covariate-adjusted projections are calculated separately.
unverified_assumptions: The Gaussian-copula bridge and exact use of rounded printed point estimates are modeling choices.
Source weighting, tie handling, missing-pair policy and pair-specific sample sizes are unresolved; a continuous equal-weight interpretation is assumed.
The rural Ashanti pooled rank structure is transferred across geography, selection, age composition and fasting serum Selectra Pro S measurement to the target recorded concentrations.
The three entries are dependent summaries from one community, not independent studies; no precision pooling or uncertainty calculation is performed.

parameter_provenance.meaning_operator: The seven named edges are assumed marginal Pearson correlations of standard-normal scores: age–sex 0.05, age–BMI 0.20, age–TC 0.15, age–HDL 0.05, sex–BMI 0.15, sex–TC 0.10 and sex–HDL 0.08.
parameter_provenance.scale: Marginal latent-score Pearson correlation, not partial correlation or raw observed-variable correlation

parameter_provenance.derivation: The seed samples individual variability only. Source estimation and transport uncertainty remain unresolved rather than being converted into individual SDs or invented parameter distributions.
unverified_assumptions: No cluster structure or unequal sampling weights are represented.
Unobserved health and lifestyle variables are not declared absent; their composition is simply not separately modeled.

requested_estimands.derivation: The centered normal equations for the raw-scale population projection give slopes V^(-1)*k_H. The displayed exact value applies the requested BMI increment and numerical lipid conversion. It incorporates age and recorded-sex dependence and is neither the source Spearman coefficient nor a transported log-scale coefficient.

The centered normal equations give slopes V^(-1)*k_T. Applying d and c yields the requested projection quantity. Its exact expression is derived from the joint raw moments rather than copied from an unadjusted source association.

Subtracting the linear projections on the same intercept, age, recorded-sex indicator and BMI gives residual covariance C_TH-k_T^T*V^(-1)*k_H and the corresponding two residual variances. Their standardized ratio is the requested Pearson correlation. Lipid unit conversion cancels.

limitations: This is an explicit cross-population scenario, not an empirically authenticated Turkana outcome model. No excluded Turkana 2018–2019 target outcomes are used.

The exact estimand expressions characterize this fixed model only. They do not identify the corresponding real target-population values, and finite generated cohorts will not exactly reproduce population moments.
Admitted extraction claims are historical provenance. Original-source reauthentication is not asserted; the supplied provenance explicitly records that it was not performed.

Navrongo's marginal summaries are dependent evidence from one cohort. Combining their margins with Ashanti dependence assumes compatibility across distinct source populations rather than reconstructing either source cohort.
The demographic mixture, site mixture, lifestyle mixture, demographic dependencies and tail behavior are not identified by target metadata. The age law has an unbounded upper tail and no age heaping.
Source pregnancy, disease, residence and complete-case restrictions are not executable target exclusions. Their transport consequences remain unresolved.

Fasting laboratory-serum source measurements are not certified equivalent to immediate CardioChek Plus measurements on target venous EDTA blood with unknown fasting status. No numerical assay bridge is available.
The joint law does not impose lipid mass balance or TC>=HDL. It can produce TC below HDL as recorded concentrations; no physiological interpretation of negative derived non-HDL is asserted.

Greiner geometric means, prevalence summaries and confidence intervals are deliberately unused. Its regression transformations remain unresolved, and its different adjustment sets and health exclusions are not imitated by dropping covariates.

Agongo's univariate log-lipid regressions are deliberately unused because their log base, conditioning and raw-scale bridge are unresolved. Ashanti's urban coefficients are not averaged with the selected rural scenario.

No confidence interval, p-value or subgroup count is used as individual dispersion or to fabricate a parameter uncertainty distribution. Fixed-scenario sampling does not imply that scientific parameter uncertainty is zero.
No numerical evaluation, software execution or generated-output validation is asserted.
